intentional_differences: Procedural layouts, prop positions, encounter choices and door offsets differ for a given seed.

Nearest visible armor or uranium wins interaction; armor now uses the full line-of-sight check.
Floor uranium uses the existing loot draw layer.
Static noise samples change, with voice, duration and gain unchanged.
